flags: The intended formula requires each adjacent pair of polygon interior angles to sum to more than 180°. This is not stated.
For example, a convex pentagon with consecutive interior angles 60°, 60°, 140°, 140°, 140° satisfies the nonparallelism conditions but does not produce the assumed exterior-tip configuration.
The intended formula requires every adjacent pair of polygon interior angles to sum to more than 180°, or an equivalent condition ensuring the illustrated exterior-tip configuration.
The construction as written can fail to produce the intended n-pointed star. Thus the literal task has no guaranteed choice, although E is the intended formula.
